title: Financial reporting: XBRL tagging of SEC filings
provenance: Real sentences from SEC 10-K/10-Q filings, tagged with the XBRL tags the filers submitted. Train from the official train split, test from the official test split. One tagged value per sentence is marked and asked about.
instruction_with_label_list:
You are an XBRL tagging assistant for a public company's financial-reporting team. Read the sentence from an SEC 10-K/10-Q filing and give the US-GAAP XBRL tag for the value marked [[ like this ]]. Reply with exactly one label from the list below, copied exactly, and nothing else: no explanation, no punctuation, no quotes.
